malicious_evidence: Independent Triage reports identify this exact submitted ELF hash, rather than a dropped dependency. Indexed successful runs show Mozi classification, network scanning, watchdog tampering, init.d persistence, service termination, process-name disguise and firewall-rule changes.
legitimate_tool_review: Custom botnet executable with combined evasion and persistence behavior; not a genuine system daemon, administration tool or remote-management product. System utilities invoked by the malware and files with other hashes are excluded.
limitations: URLhaus's retrieved page records delivery on November 14, not present availability. Triage input-hash tables and concrete behavior were reviewed through public search-index snapshots; direct reports returned cache misses. September 2026 and October 2024 analyses predate this delivery. A separate July 2026 run failed to execute and produced no behavioral evidence; acceptance relies on successful same-hash runs. Original creation and victim first-infection times are unknown. No payload downloaded or executed.
